examples.arabic: حبهم بيخلي بيتهم الصغير بيت دافي.
examples.english: Their love makes their small house a warm home.
examples.transliteration: Hobbehom byekhalli beithom el soghayar beit dafi.

examples.arabic: انا بحب عيلتي واليوم الدافي ده
examples.english: I love my family and this warm day.
examples.transliteration: ana baheb eilety wel yom eldafy da

examples.arabic: ابويا حضن اخويا جامد والجو الدافي ملى الصالة
examples.english: My dad hugged my brother tightly and the warm atmosphere filled the living room.
examples.transliteration: abouya hadan akhouya gamed wel gaw el dafy mala el sala
examples.storyTitle: The National Team Match with the Family

examples.arabic: احنا قاعدين في البيت والجو دافي
examples.english: We are sitting at home and the atmosphere is warm.
examples.transliteration: E7na 2a3deen fy el beit wel gaw dafy.

examples.arabic: الجو ده دافي وجميل مش معقول
examples.english: This warm and beautiful atmosphere is unbelievable.
examples.transliteration: El-gaww da dafy w gameel mish ma'oul.
